ios.desc:
Los Angeles. No memory. One phone. Every choice writes the next scene.

GpTA is an interactive crime story. You play Marcus "Slick" Johnson, an ex-gang member working as a getaway driver, and you decide what he does next.

HOW IT PLAYS

Each scene hands you a short prompt and four choices. Pick one and the story moves.

Your choice moves up to ten stats: health, money, wanted level, respect, stamina, muscle, lung capacity, body fat, sex appeal, and the relationship you are carrying.

Those stats change the story. Run hot and the police lean on you. Stay clean and the money comes slow. The screen itself changes with you: it recolors when you are wanted, hurt, in love, or flush.

Recurring faces cross your path: a hot headed ex fighter, an influencer, an arms dealer, and a preacher who can make a problem disappear.

The story is written as you play, so no two runs read the same.

TERRITORY

Districts unlock from your stats. Take the Docks, Downtown, and the Hills, and each one shows what it offers before it unlocks.

Your territory earns while you are away, up to a cap, and you collect it when you come back. Spend it in the shop on permanent upgrades that change how every new story starts.

SAVES

Every step is kept. Open an earlier run whenever you want and pick it up from there.

GAME CENTER

Climb the High Roller, Respect, Most Wanted, and Endurance leaderboards.
